entities.summary: Benjamin Lynch, known as Our Benny, was a Scottish professional boxer who fought in the flyweight division. He is considered by some to be one of the finest boxers below the lightweight division in his era and has been described as the greatest fighter Scotland ever produced. The Ring Magazine founder Nat Fleischer rated Lynch as the No. 5 flyweight of all-time while his publication placed him 63rd in its 2002 list of the "Best Fighters of the Last 80 Years". Like Fleischer, both Statistical boxing website BoxRec and the International Boxing Research Organization also rank Lynch as the 5th greatest flyweight ever.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Benny Lynch's achievements in boxing have been recognized by major publications such as The Ring Magazine and BoxRec, ranking him as one of the greatest flyweight boxers of all time. His legacy has contributed to Scotland's reputation for producing skilled fighters.
